FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Telecom Innovations LLC specializes in providing a range of telecommunications services, including the installation and repair of low-voltage wiring and standard consumer electronics for residential customers. Our operations include the retail sale of audio/visual equipment, like televisions and speakers, along with offering rental services for A/V gear during events, ensuring all rentals come with delivery and pickup but without on-site setup to minimize liability risks. We are committed to maintaining a robust safety program and ensuring our technicians have up-to-date training certifications. Furthermore, our operations are documented with safety protocols, and we do not subcontract installation work, which significantly reduces our exposure to third-party liability. We prioritize compliance with federal, state, and local telecommunications regulations, ensuring that our services are reliable and safe for our customers.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any activities related to utility service failures occurring off-premises and confirms that the exclusion for loss or damage to 'computer(s)' and 'electronic data' does not apply. Additionally, all contractors involved in reconstruction, erection, or repair of buildings adhere to our established standards, and any subcontracted work related to building construction, reconstruction, or repair is managed in full compliance with our operational policies.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Water damage occurred on March 10, 2023, due to a burst pipe in our office that affected our equipment and materials. The estimated loss was $3,500. Status: Claim filed and currently being processed.
